name: Desert Fairytale
description_html:
Charming Opuntia "Bunny Ear" cactus in a pink cactus print planter.

Hop on this Opuntia, otherwise known as "Bunny Ear" Cactus! The perfect gift, this plant is easy to care for – water every few weeks and keep in direct sunlight (You know, kinda like the desert.) Don't let the cute name fool you, the small white or red “dots” on Bunny Ear cacti are actually clusters of prickly spines. Be sure to use caution when handling and wear protective gloves if necessary. 

Care Instructions:

LIGHT
Place in bright, direct light

WATER
Water every few weeks. This plant is sensitive to overwatering, when in doubt, water less!

Shipping Note: Guaranteed delivery by date selected at checkout, but could arrive up to 2 days sooner. Cannot ship to Alaska or Hawaii.

name: Venice Peach
description_html:
Succulent bouquet with peach roses.

Whimsical and romantic, this Bouq has some seriously sweet vibes. Soft peach roses, spray roses, stock, and hypericum berries are complemented with white genista, eucalyptus, and spectacular plantable succulents — meaning your Bouq will live on and on! This arrangement’s waves of sunset-inspired colors are beachy peachy perfect.

Pro Tip: Your flowers will arrive fresh in our recyclable Bouqs box and may still be in bud form. This maximizes their shelf life, so they’ll last as long as possible! Please allow 2-3 days for your new buds to open and reach full bloom.

Please Note: While we always try our best to match the bouquet pictured, we remain dedicated to fresh, high-quality flowers. Occasionally substitutions including color variation or supplemental flower type may occur to ensure you receive our farmers’ freshest possible selection.

Due to local restrictions, this Bouq cannot be delivered to Hawaii.

name: Succulent Garden
description_html:
Mixed succulents in a pink, orange, and blue stoneware mug

Best For: The mom who loves plants more than anything, a hostess gift, or creating your own desert oasis 

Care Tips: Place in an area with bright, indirect sunlight and water sparingly about every 2 weeks, or when top layer of soil is completely dry. Careful not to over water.

Shipping Note: Guaranteed delivery by date selected at checkout, but could arrive up to 2 days sooner. Cannot ship to Alaska or Hawaii.

name: Love Blossom
description_html:
Pink calandiva rose plant in a pink square pot.

Fun fact: this precious pink flowering plant in a stylish square pink pot looks like a rose, but she’s actually in the succulent family (which means she’s easy to care for!).  

Care Instructions: Keep in bright, indirect sunlight and water once about every 2 weeks, allowing soil to dry out between waterings.

Shipping Note: Guaranteed delivery by date selected at checkout, but could arrive up to 2 days sooner. Cannot ship to Alaska or Hawaii.

name: Aloe You
description_html:
Hedgehog Aloe Vera plant in a pink cactus print planter.

Aloe-you. Aloe-you, too. Gift this succulent, spiny-leaved hedgehog aloe plant to someone you care for in need of low-maintenance greenery. Not only can this spiky plant absorb indoor toxins from the air, but the gel within its leaves can also soothe burns and skin irritations. Add a cactus-adorned pink pot to the mix and you’ve got a winner.

Shipping Note: Guaranteed delivery by date selected at checkout, but could arrive up to 2 days sooner. Cannot ship to Alaska or Hawaii.
